records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal year 2023, our revenue decreased by $26.8 million, or 4.0%, to $648.4 million from $675.2 million for fiscal year 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •continued growth in the demand for high-performance analog, digital and optical semiconductors in our three primary markets;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In addition, cash used by operating assets and liabilities was $27.8 million for fiscal year 2023, primarily driven by a decrease in accrued and other liabilities of $21.3 million, an increase in inventory of $10.6 million, a decrease in accounts payable of $6.7 million, partially offset by a decrease in accounts receivable of $12.3 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross margin of 59.5% in fiscal year 2023 decreased 70 basis points, compared to fiscal year 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our cash flow from operating activities for fiscal year 2023 was $166.9 million and consisted of a net income of $91.6 million, plus adjustments to reconcile our net income to cash provided by operating activities of $103.1 million, and cash used by operating assets and liabilities of $27.8 million.
